messages:
Talia Benson: Hi all — heads up that we’re publishing the updated *Pricing + Metering Guidance* next **Tue (Feb 20)** and running a live training session for Sales + CS.

- Publish: Tue 2/20 EOD PT (Confluence)
- Training: **Wed 2/21 10:00–10:45am PT / 1:00–1:45pm ET** (Zoom)
- Audience: AEs, CSMs, Support, RevOps; anyone who talks to customers about usage/invoices

RSVP: please react with :white_check_mark: if you’re planning to attend live, or :eyes: if you want the recording.

Agenda:
1) What changed (meter definitions + rounding/streaming specifics)
2) How to explain console vs invoice deltas (and what’s “expected” vs “bug”)
3) Quoting during active experiments (do’s/don’ts)
4) Escalation paths + what artifacts we need for disputes

We’ll post the link to the doc here once it’s published. cc @Rachel Kim @Isabelle Laurent @Dev Patel @Emily Stone @Chris Osei @Elliot Price

—
Rachel Kim: :white_check_mark: Thanks Talia. Quick Q: will this include a *single* customer-facing explanation we can paste into emails when they say “invoice > console”? We keep rewriting it.

Dev Patel: +1 from Support. Also can we get clarity on the streaming disconnect scenario? We’ve got one customer still convinced we’re billing “after they hang up.”

Isabelle Laurent: :white_check_mark: For AEs—will we cover whether discounts stack with promo credits in the current experiment? Been getting that question a lot.

Chris Osei: :white_check_mark: Yep, we’ll cover the experiment guardrails + what’s approved to say. We’ll also add a short “talk track” section in the FAQ.

Emily Stone: :white_check_mark: Finance request: can we include the “what to do before promising a credit” flow? We’re seeing ad hoc commitments in threads.

Elliot Price: :eyes: I can add a copy/paste template section to the Confluence page (CS + Support). If folks have examples of the best wording, drop them here and I’ll consolidate.

Wei Chen: Drafting FAQ now — if anyone has “top 5” customer questions, DM me or reply. I’m trying to keep it tight and searchable.

Chloe Martin: Will the guidance also mention why the *usage page* can lag? We’ve had some CSM confusion when invoices cut and the console totals look lower for a few hours.

Talia Benson: Great qs.

@Rachel Kim / @Dev Patel: yes — we’re adding a standard explanation block (with the 3 most common causes: timezone cutoffs, retries/outcomes, streaming partials). For streaming disconnects specifically, we’ll include: what’s billed (tokens actually generated before disconnect) and what’s not (anything after client disconnect), plus how to confirm in logs.

@Isabelle Laurent: we’ll have a slide + a one-pager on “credits + discounts” for the current Hosted experiments. (And what requires Sales Ops approval.)

@Emily Stone: agreed — adding an explicit “no credit without case + owner + approval” section, with the handoff path.

@Chloe Martin: yes. We’ll call out expected propagation delays and where to look for the billing-ready aggregates.

Nikhil Sharma: :white_check_mark: Adding one more topic request: can we cover how to quote when customer wants to pin a model version but experiment changes plan gating? We had a weird edge case last week.

Isabelle Laurent: @Nikhil Sharma +1. Also will the doc specify which SKU names to use in HubSpot/quotes? We’ve had inconsistent line items.

Chris Osei: On SKU naming: we’ll include the approved names + the invoice line item mapping section link. Sales Ops is sanity-checking it.

Elliot Price: For the pasteable blurb, would folks prefer:
A) one “short” paragraph + link to docs
B) short paragraph + bullets for common reasons
C) a longer explanation with an example calculation

Rachel Kim: B please. Short paragraph + bullets is easiest for enterprise emails.

Dev Patel: B for Support too. But include one example in the doc for internal understanding.

Emily Stone: B works. Also please include “dispute window” language (even if it’s internal reminder) so we don’t create precedent.

Talia Benson: Noted.

Logistics: I’ll send the calendar invite today. If the time doesn’t work, react with :eyes: and we’ll make sure the recording + deck are posted same day.

Elliot Price: Sharing draft link for reviewers (internal only): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/PRICING-METERING-DRAFT (WIP)
Please add comments by Fri EOD PT so we can publish Tue.

Wei Chen: :eyes: jumping in to review. I’ll add an FAQ section on “why tokens don’t equal characters” and “cached tokens” since it comes up a lot.

Chloe Martin: :white_check_mark: I’ll add notes on the console lag + timezone display.

Talia Benson: :thumbsup: thanks all. I’ll post the final link here on Tue when it’s live + the Zoom link for Wed training.
